static.title: From counts to magnitudes
static.note: A synthetic night of standard stars: their catalog magnitudes and colors are known, and the instrument’s magnitudes are made from a stated truth with noise. The fit finds the zero point, the extinction of the air and the color term; the plot shows what is left over; one target star is calibrated with the uncertainty the fit leaves. The extinction here is the atmosphere’s, in magnitudes per airmass, not the dust between the stars.
